notes:
Much lighter on your CPU. The check that watches which bots are still running fired every 8 seconds and read your whole account list three times over, dragging every bot saved script text along with it - so it spiked the CPU every few seconds all day. It now reads only what it needs, once.
The Bots page opens straight away. It used to send nearly 2MB before it could draw a single row; that is 29 times smaller now, so your accounts appear immediately.
No need to relaunch your bots for this one.
